# Sparkle license provenance

`LICENSE` is copied byte-for-byte from the verified Sparkle 2.10.0 upstream
source snapshot used for the updater audit. It includes Sparkle's MIT notice
and the bsdiff, sais-lite, Ed25519 and signature-verifier notices included by
upstream; do not replace it with an abbreviated MIT header.

Upstream: [Sparkle 2.10.0 LICENSE](https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/blob/2.10.0/LICENSE).
SHA-256 of the copied license:
`389a4e4e9a32f059775b13a06e25a591445ba229d2838d26dd3e7c0c45127cfe`.

The executable dependency's archive URL, size, checksum and minimum macOS
version are pinned separately in `runtime/sparkle-lock.json`. No framework
binary or private signing key is stored in this directory.
